semantics.input_rule: Admission consumes exact workload/profile, resource estimates, current capacity and applicable limits.

semantics.authorization_rule: Admission is separate from AccessCore authorization; both may be required.
semantics.queue_rule: Queued work retains exact original operation/request/execution provenance.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown capacity/limit follows explicit fail/defer policy.
